author: Apple
description:
The new iPad mini is thinner, lighter, and ultraportable* — now with an 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR display with OLED for deeper blacks, brilliant brights, and incredibly high contrast for your viewing pleasure.

The A20 Pro chip — an AI powerhouse — delivers a huge leap in performance, with fast, flexible multitasking powered by iPadOS. Get things done effortlessly with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI, your more personal, more powerful AI Assistant. Great front and back cameras make video calls and document scanning effortless, while Apple Pencil Pro and Apple Pencil (USB-C) helps you design, sketch, and take notes whenever inspiration strikes.

And with spill and splash resistance, it’s ready to go just about anywhere.

The new iPad mini. More than a little awesome.

Learn more about iPad mini: https://apple.co/4svDjpu

Music by Billy Lemos: https://music.apple/Billy-Lemos

*Compared with the previous generation.
